if [ -n "$GITHUB_PAT" ]; then export GH_TOKEN="$GITHUB_PAT"; fi && gh pr create --title "feat: #7 - Add filtering to the contratos aprobados tab table in the Operations department menu" --body "## Summary

This PR implements filtering functionality for the Contratos Aprobados table in the Operations department menu, allowing users to filter by any column.

## Implementation Plan

Detailed implementation plan: [specs/contratos-aprobados-filtering.md](specs/contratos-aprobados-filtering.md)

## Changes

### Frontend
- ✅ Added filter state management to FKApprovedContracts component
- ✅ Implemented filter UI with text fields for all columns
- ✅ Added debounced filter changes to reduce API calls
- ✅ Updated operationsService to support filter parameters
- ✅ Added ContractFilters type definition

### Backend
- ✅ Extended /api/operations/approved-contracts endpoint with filter parameters
- ✅ Implemented repository-level filtering with SQL WHERE clauses
- ✅ Added support for partial matching on text fields
- ✅ Maintained proper query parameter validation

### Key Features
- Filter by: Contract ID, Client Name, Document Type, Start Date, End Date, Expiration Date, Status
- Debounced input (500ms) for performance
- Responsive filter UI with clear filters button
- Backend pagination support maintained

Closes #7

**ADW ID**: 828cc1aa" --base master
